reviewItem.question: Does "The Cilium cluster name is now validated to consist of at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and '-', start and end with an alphanumeric character" mean a change to helm-value:cilium|path=cluster.name (validation-tightened)?

proposed.statement: Cilium 1.16.0 introduces validation of the cluster name to require at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and hyphens, starting and ending with alphanumeric characters; this can be temporarily bypassed with upgradeCompatibility set to v1.15 or earlier, but will be strictly enforced in v1.17.
